scope: Feasibility review only; no flags enabled, engine compiled or GPU profiler launched alongside the current full256K job.

existing_facilities.STRATA_PREFILL_TIMING: Compute-queue intervals between event/barrier end timestamps; includes host and copy gaps. Mark events fold after existing MoE synchronization, with a final fold.
existing_facilities.STRATA_PREFILL_TRANSFER_TIMING: Actual memcpy event timestamps; the copy queue factory opts into enable_profiling at initial creation when this variable is present.

findings: Current normal copy queue has profiling disabled; enabling transfer timing at next process startup changes that queue property. It is implemented, not an unsupported flag.
The benchmark program creates main_stream separately and passes main_cs to Prefill::init. The timer is therefore scoped to that source-created compute queue in this path.
dpct::sync_barrier has an additional all-queues wait only when given the default queue; other callers using null/default streams can have different timing and synchronization behavior.
STRATA_PREFILL_TIMING adds markers and two profiling-only compute waits per chunk. Its totals must not be treated as clean benchmark speed or pure device-busy time.

The current fold can suppress profiling errors through DPCT_CHECK_ERROR and still print partial totals. A controller must retain and reject profiling errors, nonfinite/negative/inconsistent or wall-exceeding timelines.
Profiling getters can block for incomplete commands and require profiling-enabled queues. Recorded graph events cannot be queried for status or timestamps.

primary_sources.supports: Event profiling requires queue profiling; getters can block until data is available.
Recorded events cannot be queried for status or profiling; graph-execution profiling has separate requirements.

next_safe_step: After current owned full job terminal/healthy/absent, use qualified DD5 with existing compute-phase timing only, initial logged fresh>=32768 head/state/output gate before a separate profile-only>=32768 run. Do not enable copy timing or repeat rejected unitrace GPU timestamps blindly.
